title: Phoneme Model Manifest
description: Records the selected phoneme-segmentation model, its benchmark results, calibrated quality thresholds, and the deterministic engine verdict.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this manifest schema.

selectedEngine.description: The inference engine selected by the deterministic selection tree.

modelRevision.description: Git revision hash pinning the exact model snapshot.

tokenizerChecksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the tokenizer vocabulary file.

modelChecksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the model weights file.

quantization.description: Quantization configuration applied to the model (if any).

quality.description: Calibrated quality thresholds frozen from the benchmark calibration sweep.

benchmark.description: Raw benchmark measurements from the probe run.

peakRssGiB.description: Peak resident set size during loading + inference, in GiB.

warmMedianMs.description: Median inference latency over warm runs, in milliseconds.

warmP95Ms.description: 95th-percentile inference latency over warm runs, in milliseconds.

coldLoadMs.description: Time to load model from disk into memory, in milliseconds.

cleanAccuracy.description: Fraction of clean corpus words whose phoneme output matches expected.

mandatoryWordsCorrect.description: Count of mandatory calibration words correctly transcribed.

corpusManifestHash.description: SHA-256 of the corpus manifest file used for accuracy testing.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this manifest was generated.

verdict.description: Final engine verdict from the deterministic selection tree.
